coverage_notes: Scope: every key reachable from Aiur.Config.Schema (183 dotted keys per scripts/check-config-docs.py re-run on the snapshot, which also passes) plus keys read outside the schema (prompt_file, hooks_file, prewarm.base_build_file, alerts.alerts_file, agent.<backend>/top-level <backend> shorthands, legacy linear:/codex:, opencode.db_path/prewarm_workspace, backend_configs sub-keys from OpenAICompat.Config @known_keys). Grouped into 39 features (config-01..39). Real-config usage: ruby YAML flatten (scratch-config/flatten.rb, flat.json, usage_matrix.tsv) over 7 current configs (aiur live, ~/.aiur/config global, ~/.aiur/config.archon, archon, kevinweaver-dev, <private repo> (private) (private), <private repo> (private) (private)) and 15 distinct historical versions (10 distinct ~/.aiur/config.bak* hashes of 12 files; 4 distinct tracked aiur/.aiur/config versions found across 49 worktree/clone checkouts deduped by md5; the snapshot copy) = 22 distinct files. 'set' = key present; 'non-default' = differs from the Ecto default. Hook keys counted in the 6 distinct hooks files. Env names from dotenv files counted by name only (values never read out). Private repos reported as counts only. Runtime evidence: 30 ~/.aiur/logs/*/log/alerts.ndjson (topic counts), telemetry.ndjson (backend-name grep), model-usage.json keys, ~/.aiur/github-budget listing. Executor evidence: python scan of 16 Executor transcripts (~/.claude/projects/-home-user-github-everdred-*/*.jsonl, scratch-config/edits.py) for Edit/Write on */.aiur/config and `aiur(dev) set` commands: 27 config edits, 13 `set max-agents`. Implementation check: python regex scan of src/lib for each key leaf outside config/schema (scratch-config/consumers.txt), then rg for callers of config.ex accessors; found 4 keys with no runtime consumer and 2 reader keys with no schema field. Not done: agent transcripts and ~/.codex/sessions were not grepped (agents do not configure Aiur); GitHub PR history per key was not mined beyond git log on schema files. LOC: wc -l on the snapshot. lib_loc counts the config layer plus modules that exist solely for a key (credential pool, ssh, rtk, bootstrap image, pr_watch scan, Linear); large shared runtimes gated by keys (dispatch_policy, build_gate, repo_base, webhooks mode registry, opencode TUI, eleven_labs, decision_api, takeover monitor, github/budget) are named in module notes but not counted, to avoid double counting with other surfaces. Partial-file figures (github/config.ex ~470 of 1090, alerts.ex ~300 of 746, target_selection ~100 of 526, agent.ex splits) are estimates. config.ex (1462) is attributed wholly to config-01. Headline: of 183 schema keys, 111 are set in none of the 22 real config files or their hook files (91 appear in neither real configs, hook files nor the 3 portable examples); 4 are documented but have no runtime effect; the most-operated keys are tracker.*, workspace.root, hooks_file/prompt_file, agent.max_concurrent_agents (+runtime set), agent.max_turns, agent.priority/routing, polling.interval_seconds, codex.approval_policy; several tuned values are explicit bug mitigations (#2278 budget ceilings, #2329 max_agent_duration_minutes).

features.name: Config loading, discovery, hot reload and accessor facade
features.description: Discovers ./.aiur/config then ~/.aiur/config, parses YAML, resolves sibling files (prompt_file, hooks_file, prewarm.base_build_file, alerts.alerts_file), normalizes legacy/alias sections (top-level linear: merged, root codex: rejected, top-level <backend>: and agent.<backend>: folded into agent.backend_configs, top-level github:/linear:/memory: infer tracker.kind, polling.interval_ms rejected), casts through the Ecto embedded schema, resolves $VAR secrets, caches in ETS via WorkflowStore (1s poll hot reload), and exposes ~114 public accessor functions in Aiur.Config. GlobalConfigStartup bootstraps labels when the global config is used.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): prompt_file set in 7/7 current (6 non-default), hooks_file 7/7. Executor transcripts (~/.claude/projects/-home-user-github-everdred-*/*.jsonl, python scan scratch-config/edits.py): 27 Edit tool calls on */.aiur/config (15 aiur, 12 architecture-docs). git log at 3339b88: config.ex 68 commits, config/schema.ex 45, reference doc 99; fixes/merged-fixes.md ranks config.ex #6 hot file (38 fix PRs of 72). The agent.<backend> shorthand is live in 2/7 current configs (global, config.archon: agent.deepseek.enabled) and in the snapshot's tracked aiur config, but appears nowhere in reference/configuration.md.
features.rationale: Loading is core and must stay, but the layer is over-built: a 1,462-line facade of ~114 accessors that mostly re-read one struct field; five spellings for backend settings (agent.claude, agent.backend_configs.claude, agent.claude shorthand, top-level claude:, registry default); and unknown keys are silently dropped by Ecto cast (a typo like max_concurent_agents is accepted and ignored; the docs call this deliberate for removed keys). Config churn is high (38 fix PRs).
features.rewrite_notes: Keep: discovery order, YAML + sibling-file resolution, $VAR resolution, ETS-cached hot reload. Remove: the per-field accessor functions (read the typed struct), all legacy/alias section folding (one canonical path per setting), GlobalConfigStartup (move label bootstrap to the GitHub package). Add: strict unknown-key rejection with a did-you-mean, and per-package schema registration (each feature package contributes its section) as codebase/feature-boundaries.md proposes.

features.name: TUI pane and opencode keys
features.description: Top-level max_vertical_panes and pre_warmed_sessions plus the opencode.* section (command, bridge_port, bridge_host, serve_args, model_prefix, prewarm_disabled) that drive the tmux/opencode chat-pane TUI. Aiur.Opencode.Config also reads opencode.db_path and opencode.prewarm_workspace, which are not schema fields.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): max_vertical_panes set 6/7, all at default 3 (0 non-default in 22 files). pre_warmed_sessions 7/7 set, 2 non-default (archon, kevinweaver-dev). opencode section set only in aiur (1/7), every value equal to its default; bridge_port and prewarm_disabled 0/22. opencode.db_path/prewarm_workspace: Opencode.Config.section_value/1 reads them from Aiur.Config.settings!().opencode, a struct with no such field, so they always resolve to nil; they are in no config and no doc.
features.rationale: The pane count is the only key operators set away from default. The opencode section is copied at defaults, and two readers target keys the schema cannot hold (implemented-but-unreachable).
features.rewrite_notes: If the TUI survives the rewrite, keep one pane-count key and pre_warmed_sessions; hardcode opencode command/bridge/model_prefix (env override for bridge port already exists as AIUR_OPENCODE_BRIDGE_PORT). Delete db_path/prewarm_workspace readers. If the opencode TUI (8,544 lib lines in src/lib/aiur/opencode, owned by the TUI surface) is cut, all of these go.

features.name: Log history cap (max_log_history_mb)

features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): set in 2/7 current (aiur at default, kevinweaver-dev non-default); 5 historical aiur versions at default. ~/.aiur/logs held 40 run directories / 865 MB on 2026-09-26 (research README), so the cap is active at default.

features.rewrite_notes: Merge with config-25 telemetry retention into one `retention:` block (log MB + telemetry bytes/age).

features.name: GitHub request budget and per-actor hourly ceilings

features.description: agent.max_turns, max_consecutive_noop_turns, max_retry_attempts, max_retry_backoff_ms, turn_timeout_ms, stall_timeout_ms, max_agent_duration_minutes, ci_wait_rewake_minutes, max_dispatches_per_ticket, prior_work_continuation, remote_control.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): max_turns 7/7 non-default (uncapped via `none` in global and config.archon; numeric in aiur/archon/kevinweaver-dev; 2 private non-default); max_agent_duration_minutes 6/7 non-default - the live aiur config sets 150 with the comment 'Raised ... as a MITIGATION, not a fix ... Restore to 60 once #2329 lands'; max_dispatches_per_ticket 2/7; stall_timeout_ms 2/7 at default; prior_work_continuation 1/7 (private, default); remote_control 0/22 (RC used through model:remote labels instead); noop/retry/turn_timeout/ci_wait 0/22.
features.rationale: Three keys are real controls; seven are never tuned; the most-changed one (max_agent_duration_minutes) is being used to paper over a slot-leak bug.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep max_turns, max_agent_duration_minutes, max_dispatches_per_ticket; hardcode the other eight (remote_control stays label-driven).

features.name: Fleet concurrency and host-load admission keys
features.description: agent.max_concurrent_agents (derived from schedulers when unset), max_concurrent_agents_by_state, max_load_average, target_load_average, load_ramp_step, load_cooldown_seconds (AIMD envelope), run_queue_threshold, min_free_memory_mb, synthetic_load_process_cap, saturation_log_enabled, capacity_starvation_alert_after_seconds.
modules: gated runtime (not counted): orchestrator/dispatch_policy.ex 1213, agent_resource_guard.ex 192, saturation_sentinel.ex 245
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): max_concurrent_agents 7/7 non-default; plus 13 `aiur(dev) set max-agents` runtime overrides in Executor transcripts (8 aiur, 3 khala, 2 architecture-docs; edits.py). max_load_average 3/7 (1 non-default); target_load_average/load_ramp_step/load_cooldown_seconds 1/7 each (kevinweaver-dev); by_state, run_queue_threshold, min_free_memory_mb, synthetic_load_process_cap, saturation_log_enabled, capacity_starvation_alert_after_seconds 0/22. meta/recurring-issues.md Rank 15 (host saturation, ~107 citations) persisted with these knobs available. test_loc = agent_resource_guard_test + saturation_sentinel_test.
features.rationale: The fleet cap is the most operated control in the whole config surface; the rest of the admission tuning is almost never touched.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep max_concurrent_agents (config + runtime set) and one load ceiling; hardcode the AIMD envelope, run-queue gate, per-state caps, synthetic-load cap, saturation toggle and starvation dwell.

features.name: Mix build gate keys
features.description: agent.max_concurrent_builds, build_start_stagger_seconds, build_gate_max_hold_seconds, build_gate_retain_seconds, mix_scheduler_cap - fleet admission for agent-launched mix compile/test.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): max_concurrent_builds 2/7 (aiur default, kevinweaver-dev non-default); build_start_stagger_seconds 2/7 non-default; mix_scheduler_cap 1/7 at default; hold/retain 0/22. Executor edits touched max_concurrent_builds (edits.py).
features.rationale: Elixir/Mix-specific; only the two Elixir repos set it. It belongs in a language plugin with the build gate itself.
features.rewrite_notes: Move with the build gate into an Elixir plugin; keep max_concurrent_builds, hardcode stagger/hold/retain/scheduler cap.

features.name: Budget-broker degraded-alert tuning
features.description: agent.budget_broker_rate_window_seconds, budget_broker_degraded_retry_threshold, budget_broker_degraded_alert_after_seconds: dwell/threshold for system.github.budget_broker_degraded.

Alert feed shows 3 system.github.budget_broker_retry lines in 30 run logs (defaults).
features.rationale: Alert-tuning knobs placed under agent.* for a GitHub-broker signal; never tuned.
features.rewrite_notes: Hardcode inside the GitHub broker module.

features.name: rtk output compression (agent.rtk.enabled)
features.description: Opt-in rtk shell-output compression for agents, admitted only when the host rtk config excludes gh; drives an analytics panel.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): agent.rtk.enabled 0/22 and 0 examples. Added 2026-09-03 (#2521, 1 commit).
features.rationale: Opt-in optimization nobody enabled; its own docs measure zero saving on common commands.
features.rewrite_notes: Remove key, module and analytics panel.

features.name: Observability and telemetry retention keys
features.description: observability.dashboard_enabled, dashboard_writable, refresh_ms, render_interval_ms, telemetry_enabled, telemetry_retention_max_bytes, telemetry_retention_max_age_days, telemetry_retention_prune_interval_bytes.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): dashboard_writable 1/7 (private); telemetry_enabled 0/22; retention keys 0/22 real (3 examples at defaults). Dead keys: python scan of src/lib (scratch-config/consumers.txt) plus `rg observability_enabled?|observability_refresh_ms|observability_render_interval_ms` found zero callers outside config.ex for dashboard_enabled, refresh_ms and render_interval_ms - documented keys with no runtime effect (the reference already labels dashboard_enabled 'Reserved compatibility setting').
features.rationale: Three of eight keys are documented but unimplemented; retention knobs are never tuned.
features.rewrite_notes: Delete dashboard_enabled/refresh_ms/render_interval_ms and their accessors; merge retention with config-03 into one section; keep dashboard_writable and telemetry_enabled.

features.name: Dashboard server bind (server.*)
features.description: server.port (0 = OS-assigned loopback) and server.host (default 127.0.0.1 or AIUR_DEFAULT_DASHBOARD_HOST; --host wins).
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): port 4/7 non-default (aiur, archon, kevinweaver-dev, 1 private); host 4/7 (3 non-default, e.g. aiur 0.0.0.0).
features.rationale: Small and used by every repo that exposes the dashboard.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep. Fix .aiur/examples/config.example, whose server comment still claims 'host omitted = authenticated Tailscale IP when available' although AGENTS.md and the reference say there is no Tailscale detection.

features.name: Supervisor decision policy (decisions.*)
features.description: decisions.supervisor_allowed_kinds and supervisor_allow_non_reversible: which Decision kinds an authenticated supervising Executor (AIUR_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN bearer) may answer through the Decision API.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): both keys 0/22 and 0 examples. AIUR_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN is present but blank in all three dotenv files that name it (~/.aiur/.env, aiur/.env, kevinweaver-dev/.env; names-only scan), so the API is disabled on every host. meta/recurring-issues.md Rank 2 (~110 citations): agents 'asked ten times over hours ... the Executor was forbidden to answer'; #2262 'supervisor token empty'. test_loc = decision_api/authority tests (shared with the decisions surface).
features.rationale: A policy layer for an API that is disabled everywhere, while the recurring failure it was meant to solve (Executor cannot answer decisions) continues.
features.rewrite_notes: Replace with one explicit Executor-authority rule in the decisions package (who may answer what), not a token + two keys + API; decide with the decisions-surface inventory.

features.name: Event digest tuning (events.*)
features.description: events.block_state_debounce_seconds, custom_events_per_turn_max, codeowners_refresh_seconds.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): all three 0/22 and 0 examples. custom_events_per_turn_max: Config.events_custom_events_per_turn_max/0 has zero callers in src/lib (rg) - documented ('Caps custom events per turn') but unimplemented.
features.rationale: Never tuned; one key does nothing.
features.rewrite_notes: Hardcode debounce and CODEOWNERS refresh in their modules; delete custom_events_per_turn_max.

features.name: Warm-base prewarm keys (prewarm.*)
features.description: prewarm.enabled, base_build (inline) / base_build_file (sibling script), poll_seconds; drives the shared pre-built base checkout (RepoBase).
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): prewarm.enabled set 7/7, true in 2 (aiur, kevinweaver-dev); base_build_file 2/7 (same two); inline base_build 0/22; poll_seconds 6/7 (1 non-default: aiur). meta/recurring-issues.md lists prewarm.enabled:false among 'config mitigations marked restore once fixed'.
features.rationale: Used by both Elixir dogfood repos; small config layer.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep; accept only the file form (inline base_build never used).

features.name: Alert sounds (alerts.*)
features.description: alerts.enabled, use_os_default_sounds, sound_dir, alerts_file (topic->sound map, .aiur/alerts; examples alerts.linux/macos.example): local audio playback for alerts.
modules: sound playback portion of src/lib/aiur/alerts.ex (~300 of 746, approx)
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): alerts.enabled set 5/7: explicitly disabled in 3 public (global, config.archon, archon) and set in 2 private; unset (default on) in aiur and kevinweaver-dev. use_os_default_sounds 4/7 (3 non-default); alerts_file 2/7 (both private); sound_dir 0/22. alerts tests (1,607 lines) mix emission and sound; sound share unknown, so test_loc left 0.
features.rationale: Desktop sound playback is a notifier concern, off in most public configs; it shares alerts.ex with the core alert feed.
features.rewrite_notes: Split alert emission (core) from sound playback; move playback to a notifier sidecar (the Stream Deck sidecar pattern) that subscribes to the feed; drop sound_dir.

features.name: PR-health scan (pr_health.*)
features.description: pr_health.enabled/interval_seconds/stale_hours: scan open PRs for unmergeable authorship, stale unreviewed PRs and rework re-queue.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): enabled in 1/7 (aiur) and 2 historical aiur versions; interval/stale at defaults. Run logs: 41 system.pr_health.stale_unreviewed + 27 system.pr_health.unmergeable_author alert lines across 30 ~/.aiur/logs/*/log/alerts.ndjson.
features.rationale: Fires real alerts in the dogfood repo; small.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep; consider default-on for GitHub and hardcode interval/stale_hours.

features.name: Repo-wide PR comment watching (pr_watch.*)
features.description: pr_watch.enabled, watch_label (agent:watch), command_prefix (/aiur): act on trusted comments on PRs Aiur did not open.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): all three keys 0/22 (commented in config.example). `rg -c '"agent:watch"'` over the research issue and label-event exports for aiur, archon, archon-docs, khala, aiur-claude, kevinweaver-dev: 0 hits. CommandScan.run returns early unless Aiur.GitHub.Config.pr_watch_enabled?/0.
features.rationale: Opt-in path never enabled, never labelled; ~700 lines plus tests.
features.rewrite_notes: Remove keys, CommandScan, PrCommandScanner and the watch-label target selection.

features.name: ElevenLabs voice keys (elevenlabs.*)
features.description: elevenlabs.api_key ($ELEVENLABS_API_KEY fallback), language_code, voice_id for Stream Deck/dashboard dictation and spoken replies.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): elevenlabs section 0/22. The credential comes only from the environment: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is set in ~/.aiur/.env and aiur/.env (names-only scan). voice_id 0/22, so Aiur.ElevenLabs.TTS (135 lines) returns 'not configured' on every host - dashboard spoken replies are unused.
features.rationale: Speech-to-text works through the env var alone; the config section adds nothing in practice and TTS is never configured.
features.rewrite_notes: Env-only credential; drop the config section (or keep voice_id only if TTS survives); move voice to a separate package with the Stream Deck.

features.name: Upgrade notice opt-out (upgrade.check_enabled)
features.description: upgrade.check_enabled toggles the `aiur run` npm version notice; AIUR_UPGRADE_CHECK_DISABLED and legacy AIUR_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER do the same.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): 0/22 and commented in config.example. The check never runs under aiurdev (reference), which is how every Executor transcript launches Aiur.

features.name: Environment variable schema and dotenv layering
features.description: Aiur.Env.Schema declares ~66 env vars (type, group, secret, docs), validates at startup, renders .env.example (CI drift check), and implements shell > ./.env > ~/.aiur/.env layering with GitHub credentials resolved as one group.
features.usage_evidence: Names-only scan of dotenv files: ~/.aiur/.env sets 8 names (+1 blank), aiur/.env 4 (+1 blank), kevinweaver-dev/.env 3 (+1 blank). Every run validates the schema at boot. Detailed per-variable usage belongs to the env/CLI surface inventory.
features.rationale: Single source for env vars with startup validation; used on every boot.
features.rewrite_notes: Keep in the config package; prune variables whose features are cut (supervisor token, Linear, voice if externalized).

features.name: Config reference docs, docs checker and annotated templates
features.description: website/docs-app/reference/configuration.md (834 lines), scripts/check-config-docs.py (169) + scripts/test-check-config-docs.sh, src/test/aiur/configuration_reference_test.exs (140), .aiur/examples/config.example (203, embedded by aiur init) and src/examples/workflows/{github-claude,github-codex,linear-codex}.yaml (294) + prompts.
features.usage_evidence: Checker re-run against the snapshot (copy with REPO_ROOT patched): 'all 183 config keys are documented'. Reference doc 99 commits, config.example 62 commits (git log at 3339b88). Drift found: (1) 4 documented keys have no runtime consumer (observability.dashboard_enabled/refresh_ms/render_interval_ms, events.custom_events_per_turn_max); (2) the agent.<backend> and top-level <backend> shorthands, used in 2 live configs, are undocumented; opencode.db_path/prewarm_workspace readers are undocumented and unreachable; (3) config.example says server.host omitted = Tailscale IP, contradicting the reference; (4) agent.codex.reset_time_zone doc names a `worker_host` key that does not exist (the key is worker.ssh_hosts); (5) the two GitHub examples set ~27 keys at their defaults (8 build_order, 10 budget, 3 planning, 2 telemetry retention, 2 takeover, 2 others) and github-codex.yaml sets polling.interval_seconds: 30 against the documented budget rationale; (6) the aiur snapshot config comment says deepseek needs enabled:true despite being in priority, which the reference says auto-enables.
features.rationale: Three hand-maintained copies (schema comments, reference table, templates) plus a regex checker keep drifting; the checker only proves a key string appears, not that it works.
features.rewrite_notes: Generate the reference table and the annotated template from the schema (type, default, one-line doc per field) and delete the regex checker and configuration_reference_test; shrink examples to non-default essentials. Estimated ~400 non-lib doc/template lines removable (counted in loc_saving_estimate).

features.name: Config.Paths state-directory registry
features.description: Aiur.Config.Paths: log root, repo name, sanitize, and per-repo durable state directories (decisions, usage ledger, executor, takeover, balance baseline...). Not operator config keys.
features.usage_evidence: codebase/feature-boundaries.md: Config.Paths has 20 boundary callers. No config key; used on every run.
features.rationale: A runtime-state path registry living in the config namespace; it couples every stateful package to Config.
features.rewrite_notes: Move to a small runtime-state/paths package (merge with the state-store surface); each package registers its own path key.

features.name: Memory tracker kind (tracker.kind: memory)
features.description: In-memory tracker adapter selected by tracker.kind: memory (or a top-level memory: section); flat workspace layout.
features.usage_evidence: Real-config scan (22 distinct files: 7 current incl. 2 private + 15 historical; flatten.rb/usage_matrix.tsv, see coverage_notes): tracker.kind is github in every real config; `rg '"memory"|kind: memory'` finds 37 test files using it and no launcher/script path (scripts/aiurdev, aiur-engine.sh) selecting it.
features.rationale: A test double shipped in the release.
features.rewrite_notes: Move to test support (or a test-only package); drop the memory: section inference.
